title: Terms and Conditions
description: Read our terms and conditions of use to understand your rights and responsibilities when using Hospeda.

aceptacion.title: Acceptance of the terms
aceptacion.body: By accessing and using the Hospeda platform (the “Service”), you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to any part of these terms, you may not use the Service.

uso-servicio.title: Use of the service
uso-servicio.body: The Service helps travelers discover accommodations, places to eat and go out, experiences, events and other tourism resources, and get in touch with providers. You agree to use the Service only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. If you use the AI tools, check details that affect your trip, such as prices and availability, with the provider.

registro.title: Account registration
registro.body: To use certain features of the Service, you must create an account with accurate, complete and current information. You can also sign up with your Google or Facebook account. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account. You can ask us to close your account through the contact form; to close it, there can be no active plans or published listings.

publicacion.title: Publishing listings
publicacion.body: Providers who list accommodations, places to eat and go out, experiences or other services guarantee that the information they enter is truthful, accurate and complete. For a listing to be published, it must be covered by a current plan or a trial period; if it stops being covered, it is no longer shown. If a listing stays inactive, it is archived, and if it remains archived its content is deleted when the retention period ends. We notify you by email before archiving it and before deleting it. Reviews, replies and messages are automatically reviewed to detect prohibited content. Hospeda reserves the right to review, modify or remove any listing that does not meet its policies.

reservas.title: Reservations and payments
reservas.body: Reservations and their payments are arranged directly between the traveler and the provider: Hospeda facilitates contact and does not process those payments. Hospeda charges for its own plans (for providers, and the VIP plan for travelers) and its add-ons. Automatic charges are processed through Mercado Pago; in specific cases, the administration may record a payment made by other means. Monthly and annual plans renew automatically at the end of each period until you cancel them. When a promotion is running, you can apply a promo code when you sign up. Before you buy, we show you the price, the billing period and what the plan includes. We issue a receipt for every charge. If a charge is declined, the plan enters a grace period; if the charge is not settled, the plan stops covering your listings.

prueba.title: Trial period
prueba.body: Some plans for providers of accommodations, places to eat and go out and experiences include a free trial period granted by Hospeda. The trial starts when you publish your first listing, requires no payment method and, when it ends, does not trigger any automatic charge: to keep publishing you need to buy a plan. The length of the trial is shown before it starts.

cancelaciones.title: Cancellations and refunds
cancelaciones.body: Reservation cancellation and refund terms depend on the provider and what was agreed at booking. You can cancel your Hospeda plan at any time from the Subscription section of your account. Once you cancel, no new charges are made and you keep the service until the end of the period already paid. If your plan allows it, you can also pause it or switch to another plan. We give refunds when you exercise the right of withdrawal within 10 calendar days of the charge (in that case we refund that charge in full, plus the last charge of any add-ons that depended on that plan) and when we detect a wrong, duplicate or late charge. Every refund is confirmed by the administration and is processed through the same payment method or, if that is not possible, by bank transfer. Except in those cases, cancelling a plan does not give a refund for the current period. To exercise the right of withdrawal, use the link in this section.

propiedad-intelectual.title: Intellectual property
propiedad-intelectual.body: All platform content, including text, images, logos, designs and software, is owned by Hospeda or its respective owners. Reproduction without express permission is prohibited.

limitacion.title: Limitation of liability
limitacion.body: Hospeda does not guarantee uninterrupted availability of the Service or the accuracy of information provided by third parties. Under no circumstances are we liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages.

modificaciones.title: Changes
modificaciones.body: We reserve the right to change these Terms at any time. Changes take effect when published on the platform. Continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

contacto.title: Contact
contacto.body: If you have questions about these Terms and Conditions, contact us at info@hospeda.com.ar or through our contact form.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.description: How to withdraw from a Hospeda subscription within 10 calendar days of the charge.
withdrawal.intro: If you bought a Hospeda subscription, you can withdraw from it within 10 calendar days of the day of the charge you want to revoke (Resolution 424/2020, Argentina).
withdrawal.effects: Once we record your request, the subscription is cancelled, the service ends at that moment and we request a refund of that charge in full.
withdrawal.howTo: Send us your request through the contact form: you do not need to sign in. Include the email of your Hospeda account.
withdrawal.mailAlternative: You can also write to us at {{email}}.
